name: How long does tile flooring installation take?
description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity, typically 1-2 days for small rooms and 3-5+ days for larger or more complex areas.

mainEntity.name: How long does tile flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of tile flooring installation varies based on the project's size, complexity, and the type of tile. A small room might take 1-2 days, while larger areas or intricate patterns can extend to 3-5 days or more. This timeframe includes preparing the subfloor, laying the tile, and allowing for grout to cure. Our team will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity, typically 1-2 days for small rooms and 3-5+ days for larger or more complex areas.
